**Welcoming Commitee** is a quest in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Burning Springs* update.

From anywhere in Appalachia, the Vault Dweller can listen to the Ohio Distress Broadcast. Ava is calling for aid on the other side of Point Pleasant's Silver bridge, which has now been rebuilt by the Cult of the Mothman. The Vault Dweller can cross the bridge, where they have to defeat members of The Rust King's army. After defeating the Raiders, the Vault Dweller can travel to the top of a tower where they can meet Ava. She claimed on the radio to be looking for medicine for her "papa" but after flirting with the Vault Dweller slips and says she was helping her "mama." Realizing her ruse is up, the Vault Dweller gets knocked on the back of the head by an unknown figure and blacks out.

When the Vault Dweller wakes up, they are inside a jail cell of The Rust Kingdom where they can speak with Silas and or Eugene, other prisoners of the Rust King. The Vault Dweller is released from their cell and must speak with the Rust King himself who pits the Vault Dweller up his Rust Raider soldiers and their Deathclaws. After defeating them the Vault Dweller is free to go and explore the rest of Burning Springs.
